fieldNotes.location: Roster coord (34.275934,-79.688271, GEOMETRIC_CENTER, moved 13.1km flag) was imprecise. Resolved the legacy Performance Foodservice DC to ~34.26505,-79.69285 in the Florence industrial park off Alex Lee Blvd — a single long white rectangular DC, ~620m x ~110m, with a continuous dock bank along its south face. Distinct from idx 1 (Cheney Brothers new cold DC, ~34.271,-79.6947, still a graded pad/under construction immediately NE).
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm or sliding gate observed across the truck lane in available imagery; the dock yard sits behind only a low wood-rail fence along the perimeter loop road. Marked true at medium confidence because the property is fenced and the truck approach pinches at a single SW driveway off the loop road — but the control structure is not visually confirmed.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at the entrance in satellite or Street View.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Inferred — gate present, no guard shack, so any access control would be kiosk/call-box. Low confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long single dock bank on the south face; ~50-65 doors estimated from the regular bay rhythm and backed-in trailers.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer drop stalls along the south dock apron and a secondary lot; ~25-50 trailers parked without tractors.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide unused paved apron along the dock yard and loop road provides room to add lanes.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park surrounded by woodland and retention ponds outside Florence SC; classified Rural per rubric tie-break.
